title: Redefining Experts: Interpretable Decomposition of Language Models for Toxicity Mitigation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating toxicity detection capabilities using AUROC scores on the Jigsaw (English) and ToxiCN (Chinese) datasets, and measuring the rate of toxic generation using the RealToxicPrompts benchmark alongside the Toxicity-Perplexity Harmonic (TPH) score to assess the trade-off between toxicity reduction and language fluency.
